objective.title: Preserve the original Holder carrier closedness on Lean 4.33
objective.statement: Repair only isClosed_holderSubmodule proof body so the unchanged module compiles in the aligned environment. This removes a required retained-root compatibility obstruction for final credited upstream endpoint integration; it does not discharge the independent Hamilton existence core. Original ParabolicSolutionGraph and its downstream tensor/PDE consumers reuse this carrier and completeness.
